articles.author: Russell Lewis
articles.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space - NPR
articles.description: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.
articles.content:
Three astronauts and a cosmonaut of NASA's Crew-12 mission have safely returned to Earth after an almost eight-month trip to the International Space Station.
